02 — SYSTEM LOOP

整体架构：一条闭合的飞行控制回路Overall architecture: one closed flight-control loop

制导给出加速度指令，控制转成舵偏，弹体在气动与推进作用下运动，导航与导引头再把状态测回来。Guidance issues acceleration commands, control converts them to fin deflections, the airframe responds under aero and thrust, and navigation and the seeker measure the state back.

一句话原理：In one sentence: 导引头测量弹目视线，导航给出自身状态，制导算出该往哪拐，控制把“往哪拐”变成舵偏，弹体在气动与推力作用下飞向目标。 The seeker measures the line of sight, navigation provides the missile state, guidance decides where to turn, control converts that into fin deflections, and the airframe flies toward the target under aero and thrust.

03 — TRAJECTORY & PHASES

弹道剖面与飞行阶段Trajectory and Flight Phases

垂直冷发射 → 重力转弯助推 → 定动压中制导巡航 → 末段俯冲拦截，三段时间边界由速度、高度、动压与交班门限共同决定。Vertical cold launch → gravity-turn boost → constant-q midcourse cruise → terminal dive, with phase boundaries set by speed, altitude, dynamic pressure and handover gates.

事件与终止条件Events and termination

  • 脱靶事件：弹目距离率由负转正，取最近点Miss event: range rate turns from negative to positive at closest approach
  • 落地事件：地心距等于地球半径Ground impact: geocentric radius equals Earth radius
  • 事件用方向感知判零 + 二分定位，脱靶量取自步内 RK4 重构状态Direction-aware root finding plus bisection; miss distance taken from the in-step RK4 reconstructed state
  • 无事件时用遥测最小距离兜底Falls back to the minimum telemetry range if no event fires

能量与高度管理Energy and altitude management

  • 中制导远距离保持动压 75 kPa，对应约 30 km 巡航高度Midcourse holds 75 kPa q, about 30 km cruise altitude
  • 下降起点按需提前（最晚 520 km，标称约 300 km），先抬升再俯冲；剖面目标交班优势 1 km、下沉角约 -2.4°，当前单发实际交班约 1.2 km / -6.6°The descent entry is scheduled as needed (at most 520 km, about 300 km nominal), then the profile lofts and dives; it targets a 1 km handover advantage at about -2.4°, while the current single shot arrives at about 1.2 km / -6.6°
  • 150 km 内冻结参考轨迹，避免 t_go→0 曲率发散Reference path frozen inside 150 km to avoid curvature blow-up as t_go→0
  • 当前峰值动压 881.3 kPa，最大高度 29.93 kmCurrent peak q 881.3 kPa, max altitude 29.93 km

05 — GUIDANCE & CONTROL

制导与控制Guidance and Control

助推段解决能量与姿态，中制导解决航程与交班几何，末制导解决高动态终局；三回路自动驾驶仪负责把过载指令变成舵偏。Boost handles energy and attitude, midcourse handles range and handover geometry, terminal handles the high-dynamics endgame; a three-loop autopilot turns load-factor commands into fin deflections.

BOOST

助推：垂直冷发射 + 重力转弯Boost: cold launch + gravity turn

  • 前 2 s 垂直上升，姿态保持First 2 s vertical ascent with attitude hold
  • 爬升角速率取 min(8°/s, 可用过载/V)Climb-rate limit min(8°/s, available load / V)
  • 指令法向过载 4 g，500 m 以下加 1.5 g 拉起保护4 g normal command, plus 1.5 g pull-up below 500 m
  • 推力法向分量去重，避免重复计数Thrust normal component de-duplicated
MIDCOURSE

中制导：Bezier + 抬升-俯冲 + 预测Midcourse: Bezier + loft-dive + prediction

  • 三维三次 Bezier，每 10 s 重规划，2 s 交叉淡入3D cubic Bezier, replanned every 10 s, 2 s crossfade
  • PN 增强 N=2.0，动压保持 75 kPaPN enhancement N=2.0, q-hold at 75 kPa
  • 先抬升再俯冲：两段 Hermite，末端斜率约束为交班下沉角Loft then dive: two-segment Hermite with the terminal slope constrained to the handover descent angle
  • 角度约束反馈把实际航迹角拉向剖面目标，预测项把交班 ZEM 横向分量提前消掉Angle-constraint feedback tracks the profile's flight-path angle; a predictive term removes the lateral ZEM at handover early
  • 指令限幅 5 g，横向约束 3 g，抬升/俯冲通道各自限幅5 g command limit, 3 g lateral, separately capped loft/dive channels
TERMINAL

末制导：ZEM/APNTerminal: ZEM/APN

  • 导航延迟外推 + t_go = max(R/Vc, 下限)Nav-delay extrapolation, t_go = max(R/Vc, floor)
  • ZEM 含目标加速度前馈，30 ms 低通ZEM includes target-acceleration feedforward, 30 ms LPF
  • 自适应 N：接近时提升 40%，下限 3Adaptive N: 40% boost near endgame, floor 3
  • 40 g 限幅，FOV 边缘软保护40 g limit, soft FOV-edge protection

全部门限连续保持 0.2 s；30 km 内高度门限不满足时可强制交班。交班后 0.5 s 内按权重混合中/末制导指令。All gates must hold 0.2 s; forced handover is allowed inside 30 km if the altitude gate cannot be met. Midcourse and terminal commands are blended for 0.5 s after handover.

三回路自动驾驶仪Three-loop autopilot

a_cmd → α/β_cmd → 2nd-order prefilter → rate loop → virtual fin → mixer
虚拟攻角限幅Virtual AoA limit±25°（包线 20°）
侧滑限幅Sideslip limit8°@70 kPa，随动压放大
指令预滤波Command prefilterζ=0.707, 1–10 Hz
外环增益Outer-loop gainsKpα=6.0, Kiα=0.75；Kpβ=3.6
角速率内环Rate-loop gainsKpq=0.14, Kpp=0.035（q 调度）
滚转指令Roll command4/s 对齐 + 0.25 s 平滑
舵偏 / 舵速率Fin deflection / rate±25° / 150°/s
舵机时间常数Actuator time constant10 ms
过载内环Load-factor loopn_z PI + 0.06 s 超前

含抗积分饱和、位置饱和反算、低动压积分冻结与舵机饱和反馈。攻角/侧滑包线把升力限制在可用升力线内，滚转指令限幅防止高攻角下 α·p 耦合把机体推出包线。Includes anti-windup, back-calculation, low-q integration freeze and actuator-saturation feedback. AoA/sideslip envelopes keep the lift vector inside the usable lift line, and the roll-command limiter prevents the α·p coupling from pushing the airframe out of envelope at high alpha.

舵面混合与限幅Fin mixing and limiting

δ_up = δ_down = δ_Y    δ_left = δ_P − δ_R    δ_right = δ_P + δ_R

处理顺序：速率限幅 → 一阶滞后 → 位置限幅。四舵十字布局，饱和标志回送姿态控制抗饱和回路。Processing order: rate limit → first-order lag → position limit. Cruciform four-fin layout; the saturation flag feeds back to the attitude-control anti-windup loop.

06 — NAVIGATION & SEEKER

导航与探测Navigation and Seeker

GNSS/INS 12 状态卡尔曼滤波提供延迟 50 ms 的导航输出；双模导引头在末段提供视线角、角速率、距离与距离率。A 12-state GNSS/INS Kalman filter provides navigation output with 50 ms delay; the dual-mode seeker supplies LOS angles, LOS rates, range and range rate in the endgame.

GNSS/INS 组合导航GNSS/INS navigation

  • 12 状态：位置、速度、加速度计零偏、陀螺零偏12 states: position, velocity, accelerometer bias, gyro bias
  • 常加速度预测 + 一阶 Gauss-Markov 零偏Constant-acceleration prediction with first-order Gauss-Markov biases
  • GNSS 1 Hz 更新，位置 8 m、速度 0.15 m/s（1σ）1 Hz GNSS update, 8 m position and 0.15 m/s velocity (1σ)
  • 输出延迟 50 ms，用 deque 实现50 ms output delay via a deque buffer

失锁 / 虚警率Dropout / false-lock rate0.05 / 0.01 s⁻¹

闪烁噪声 σ = 0.30 × 15.7 m / R，与角度噪声合成后经 20 ms 低通得到视线角速率。Glint σ = 0.30 × 15.7 m / R; combined with angle noise and low-pass filtered at 20 ms to produce LOS rate.

双模锁定逻辑Dual-mode lock logic

lock = (θ_FOV ≤ 20°) ∧ (R > 200 m) ∧ (R ≤ R_lock)
R_lock = max( R_radar, R_IR )

雷达按 RCS 四次方根缩放，红外与 RCS 无关；因此对隐身目标，红外通道决定有效锁定距离。Radar scales with the fourth root of RCS while IR is RCS-independent; for stealthy targets the IR channel therefore sets the effective lock range.

目标跟踪与中制导数据链Target tracking and midcourse datalink

  • 转换量测卡尔曼滤波估计目标 6 状态Converted-measurement Kalman filter estimates the 6-state target
  • 未锁定时由数据链 1 s 修正一次Before lock, a 1 Hz datalink provides corrections
  • 数据链噪声 200 m / 4 m·s⁻¹，延迟 0.2 s，丢失率 2%Datalink noise 200 m / 4 m·s⁻¹, 0.2 s latency, 2% loss
  • 2 km 预置误差下，有数据链可回到十米级，无数据链则偏出数公里With a 2 km cue bias, the datalink restores metre-level accuracy; without it the aim point is off by kilometres

08 — VERIFICATION & LIMITS

验证、假设与适用边界Verification, Assumptions and Limits

单元测试全部通过，但全包线性能验证仍未达标；本仓库用于算法与架构验证，不做实装性能鉴定。Unit tests pass, yet full-envelope performance validation has not met its acceptance criterion. This repository verifies algorithms and architecture, not fielded-system performance.

测试与性能验证Tests and performance validation

对当前代码复跑 pytest：11 个测试模块、72 个用例全部通过。pytest on the current code: 11 modules, all 72 cases pass.

72 / 72 passed 13 数据一致性consistency 12 控制control 11 制导guidance 9 气动锚点aero 8 集成integration 5 fastcore 4 敏感器sensors 4 批量batch 3 状态模式schema 2 分析analysis
性能验证（output/validation）：Performance validation (output/validation): 6 个场景套件中目标速度、目标高度、组合工况达到 80%；基线 4/4 满足 ≤15 m（均值 10.70 m）；机动 50%、几何 70%（最差 44.3 m，不再出现 486.7 km 飞越），整体仍为 FAIL。单元测试全绿不等于全包线命中率达标。 The target-speed, altitude and combined suites clear 80%; the baseline passes 4/4 at ≤15 m (10.70 m mean); maneuver 50% and geometry 70% (worst 44.3 m, no 486.7 km fly-past), so the overall verdict remains FAIL. Green unit tests do not imply full-envelope hit-rate compliance.
蒙特卡洛（100 例，种子 2026）：Monte Carlo (100 cases, seed 2026): 79% 命中（≤15 m，95% CI 70.0–85.8%），CEP50 9.27 m，CEP90 17.96 m；91 例 ≤20 m、99 例 ≤30 m，无远距离离群，最大 34.9 m。 79% hit rate (≤15 m, 95% CI 70.0–85.8%), CEP50 9.27 m, CEP90 17.96 m; 91 cases within 20 m, 99 within 30 m, no long-range outlier, worst case 34.9 m.

数值可信度Numerical credibility

  • RK4 阶数、开普勒守恒、长时四元数范数、RK4/RK45 交叉比对RK4 order, Kepler invariants, long-run quaternion norm, RK4/RK45 cross-check
  • 气动表对 DATCOM、经典理论、精确激波关系三方校核Aero tables cross-checked against DATCOM, classical theory and exact shock relations
  • 启动时强制执行参考面积、比冲、惯量、静稳定裕度、质心行程校验Start-up enforces checks on reference area, specific impulse, inertia, static margin and CG travel
  • 固定种子重复一致，Numba 与纯 Python 逐值对齐Fixed-seed runs are reproducible; Numba and pure Python agree value by value

主要假设Main assumptions

  • WGS84 椭球 + J2 引力，不含地形；可选 6371 km 球模型WGS84 ellipsoid + J2 gravity, no terrain; optional 6371 km sphere
  • 默认无风、无大气扰动；风模型为可选项No wind or atmospheric disturbance by default; wind model optional
  • 目标为 3DOF 质点，固定迎头 RCS，无姿态/频率起伏Target is a 3DOF point mass with fixed head-on RCS and no attitude/frequency fluctuation
  • 气动系数为 DATCOM + 理论外推，未经本飞行器风洞/试飞标定Aero coefficients are DATCOM plus theoretical extrapolation, not calibrated on this vehicle
  • 导引头为简化双模模型，不含杂波、干扰、多径、云衰减Seeker is a simplified dual-mode model without clutter, jamming, multipath or cloud attenuation
  • 舵机为一阶滞后 + 速率/位置限幅，无间隙、死区、结构柔性Actuator is first-order lag with rate/position limits, no backlash, dead band or structural flexibility
  • 未建模气动加热、结构强度、热防护与气动弹性Aerodynamic heating, structural strength, thermal protection and aeroelasticity are not modelled
  • 未建模数据链组网、协同交战与飞行中指令更新Datalink networking, cooperative engagement and in-flight command updates are not modelled

适用范围Scope

  • 适用：制导/控制/导航算法设计与对比、弹道方案权衡、能量管理研究、蒙特卡洛脱靶量统计、软件架构与测试方法验证Suitable for: guidance/control/navigation design and comparison, trajectory trade studies, energy-management research, Monte-Carlo miss statistics, software architecture and test-method verification
  • 不适用：系统性能鉴定、作战级命中概率评估，或任何实弹运用决策Not suitable for: system qualification, operational hit-probability assessment, or any live-fire employment decision
